metadata.source: PSOC - MiniPlasma WERPipe Named Pipe Access.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - MiniPlasma WERPipe Named Pipe Access
properties.description: Detects access to the "MiniPlasmaWERPipe" named pipe, a known indicator of the MiniPlasma Windows privilege-escalation zero-day.
properties.query:
DeviceEvents
| where ActionType == "NamedPipeEvent"
| where AdditionalFields has "MiniPlasmaWERPipe"
| project
    Timestamp,
    DeviceName,
    ActionType,
    InitiatingProcessFileName,
    InitiatingProcessSHA256,
    InitiatingProcessId,
    InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
    AccountName,
    PipeName = parse_json(AdditionalFields).PipeName  // Only parse when needed
| extend
  Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceName", "")),
  Account = tostring(column_ifexists("AccountName", "")),
  ProcessId = tostring(column_ifexists("InitiatingProcessId", "")),
  CommandLineMapped = tostring(column_ifexists("InitiatingProcessCommandLine", ""))
| where PipeName == @"\Device\NamedPipe\MiniPlasmaWERPipe"
| sort by Timestamp desc
| take 10  // Limit results
